headword: {応急手当|おうきゅうてあて}

definitions.explanation: Immediate, temporary care given to an injured or sick person on the spot, before a doctor or ambulance takes over. Includes stopping bleeding, bandaging, and cooling burns.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{応急手当|おうきゅうてあて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I gave first aid to the wound.

examples.japanese: ⟦けが→けが：00787_kega⟧⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{応急手当|おうきゅうてあて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{運|はこ}んだ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: We gave the injured person first aid and then took them to the hospital.

examples.japanese: やけど⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦{冷|ひ}やす→冷やす：02403_hiyasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧{応急手当|おうきゅうてあて}だ。
examples.english: If you get burned, cooling it first is the correct first-aid treatment.

notes:
"⟦{応急|おうきゅう}→応急：08193_oukyuu⟧" (emergency, stopgap) + "⟦{手当|てあて}→手当：04881_teate⟧" (treatment). Refers to temporary on-the-spot care, not full medical treatment. Also written ⟦{応急処置|おうきゅうしょち}→応急処置：06519_oukyuushochi⟧. Takes ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {応急手当|おうきゅうてあて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {応急手当|おうきゅうてあて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give first aid
- {応急手当|おうきゅうてあて}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧: first-aid methods

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{応急処置|おうきゅうしょち}→応急処置：06519_oukyuushochi⟧: emergency measures — near-synonym, slightly more formal and also used for objects/machines
- ⟦{手当|てあて}→手当：04881_teate⟧: treatment — the general word for medical care of a wound
